summary: The main article describes a photoredox-catalyzed decarboxylative alkylation of 3-aryl-oxetanes and azetidines. It includes optimization tables, reaction scopes for various substrates, and detailed computational and mechanistic studies to explain the unique reactivity of four-membered ring radicals.
